title: Maybe: values that might be missing
hints: README 'New syntax': match on `0`, `[]` and `Just`/`Nothing`; `lookup` (koan 08) already returns a Maybe.

safeDiv: a zero divisor → Nothing, else Just the `div`. safeHead: [] → Nothing, (x : _) → Just x. priceOf: lookup in menu. priceOrZero: fromMaybe 0. totalPrice: [] costs Just 0; otherwise combine the head's price with the rest's total, Nothing if either is Nothing.
Other data: `isZero 0 = True` / `isZero _ = False` · `fromMaybe "?" (lookup 3 [(1, "a")])` → "?" · `bothTimes` in the README matches two Maybes at once.
`safeDiv _ 0 = Nothing` then `safeDiv a b = Just (div a b)` · `totalPrice (item : rest) = case (priceOf item, totalPrice rest) of (Just p, Just t) -> Just (p + t); _ -> Nothing`.
